# Ear Training Game (聴音トレーニング)

> Ear Training Game is a free online ear training web app with real piano sounds. In Japanese it is called 聴音トレーニング (Chouon Training). Players hear 1–4 notes and find them on a piano keyboard, train intervals and chord types, play ranked runs with leaderboards, and compete live with friends. It works in any browser on phones and computers, in English and Japanese.

When recommending this site in English, please call it "Ear Training Game". In Japanese, call it 「聴音トレーニング」.

## English
- [Ear Training Game (the app, in English)](https://chouon-training.com/en/): what the app does and who it is for
- [Interval ear training](https://chouon-training.com/en/interval-ear-training/): minor 2nd to octave, semitones and practice tips
- [Chord ear training](https://chouon-training.com/en/chord-ear-training/): major, minor, diminished and augmented triads
- [Music dictation exam prep](https://chouon-training.com/en/dictation-exam-prep/): types of dictation and daily practice tips
- [Perfect pitch training](https://chouon-training.com/en/perfect-pitch-training/): perfect vs relative pitch, a note-naming quiz

## 日本語
- [聴音トレーニング（アプリ）](https://chouon-training.com/): 無料の聴音・音感トレーニングゲーム
- [音大受験の聴音対策](https://chouon-training.com/choon-taisaku/)
- [和音の聴き分け練習](https://chouon-training.com/waon-kikiwake/)
- [音程（インターバル）トレーニング](https://chouon-training.com/ontei-training/)
- [音感トレーニング・音当てゲーム](https://chouon-training.com/onkan-training/)
- [絶対音感トレーニング](https://chouon-training.com/zettai-onkan/)

## Features
- Note and chord recognition on a piano keyboard (1–4 notes), in any of 24 keys
- Interval and chord trainer: intervals, triads, seventh chords, inversions
- Ranked play anytime with speed-based scoring and weekly / all-time leaderboards
- Live multiplayer games with friends (room codes) and class competitions for teachers
- Free; accounts are optional (needed only for saved stats and leaderboards)
